title: Microsoft 365 Copilot app: redesigned navigation pane with longer chat history and quick create for Notebooks and agents
summary: The roadmap details and both admin paths are supported. The briefing overstates what the default settings make available: agent access remains subject to app policies and user assignments, and disabling OneDrive creation prevents Notebook creation even when its Cloud Policy is enabled. The one-click creation claim and assertion that the redesign leaves access unchanged are not documented.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Cloud Policy governs creation and use of Copilot Notebooks in the app.
claims.quote: IT administrators can control creation and use of Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Cloud Policy settings.

claims.claim: The Notebook policy is reached in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center through Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. Select Policy Management. Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. From the Choose the scope dropdown list ... In Configure Settings ... For Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy can be scoped to All users or a group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls table; Why it matters
claims.claim: The Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks policy defaults to Enabled.
claims.quote: | Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation | Cloud Policy: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks | Enabled |

claims.claim: Not configured has the same enabling behaviour as Enabled for the Notebook creation policy.
claims.quote: Enabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration are available to the users. Not configured: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration are available to the users.

claims.claim: A tenant using the policy defaults has Notebooks available.
claims.quote: If your organization disabled the creation of OneDrive, regardless of the setting noted here, these people in your organization can't create Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks.
claims.fix: Replace 'Notebooks are available' with 'the Notebooks creation policy is Enabled by default, although users whose OneDrive creation is disabled cannot create Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks'. The qualification is at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-admin-configuration.

claims.claim: Disabling Notebook creation through Cloud Policy hides the Notebooks module in the Copilot app.
claims.quote: When creation is disabled, users are unable to create new Copilot Pages or Notebooks. The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.
